name: Little League Elbow / Medial Apophysitis
definition: Overuse injury of the medial elbow growth plate in skeletally immature throwing athletes due to repetitive valgus stress.

redFlags.item: Loss of extension with major swelling

investigations.principle: Radiographs are used for persistent pain or suspected physeal widening/avulsion.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Continuing to throw through pain risks growth-plate injury.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kurpara/Asthi-Snayu overuse phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Overuse injury of the medial elbow growth plate in skeletally immature throwing athletes due to repetitive valgus stress.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
